content: Kriti Mahajan inquired about renewing her expired auto policy, asking for the official reinstatement form, details on the $1,250 reinstatement fee, and confirmation of the 30-day reinstatement window deadline. Karan Joshi responded by sending the requested form, confirming the policy expired on 15 September 2026, and stating the deadline to reinstate with back-dated coverage is 15 October 2026.

action_items: Sign and return the reinstatement form if proceeding
Process the $1,250 payment upon form submission
